verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core is an open-source framework (crewai-gh-1, crewai-docs-55). Agent and model settings can live in YAML that you version-control yourself (crewai-docs-24), so crew definitions are portable by construction. Deployed AMP crews also expose a REST API with execution status endpoints (crewai-docs-65, crewai-docs-57). However, nothing in the evidence documents a data-export capability for AMP-hosted data such as memory stores, traces, execution history or Crew Studio builds, nor any open export formats or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: documented export of AMP/managed-platform data, export of memory and trace data in open formats, an account offboarding path, independent corroboration of portability.
